$comment: Pairs that are deliberately similar, read by scripts/check-content-names.mjs.
Each entry is a decision someone wrote down: the reason is mandatory and the check refuses a
placeholder. An entry only silences the pair it names — everything else still fails, and the
check prints every allowlisted pair with its reason on each run. An entry that no longer
matches a live collision is reported as STALE; delete it then, because a leftover permit would
silently cover a name that comes back later.

allow.reason: D5 defect 6: the Tolvaren harbour-master's byname is being renamed by F2; the pair is recorded so the class of defect stays visible until that lands.
D5 defect 6: same byname as above, one letter from the Wound zone's attested form; F2 renames it.
D5 defect 7: the Wound zone is one letter from the being's Calethic name; F2 renames the zone, not the being.
Both are attested forms in calethic-language.md (raeth root and the vaeld+raeth junction row); the one-letter gap is in canon, not an authored coinage, so a design card must not rename either.
D5 recorded Drakeld as the root dictionary's example compound for drak (stone), not an attested name or place, and declined to block; revisit if it is ever attested as a name.
